facts.fact: Health Minister Mustapha Ferjani said on 2025-02-20 that the ministry is developing a Tunisian AI software with InstaDeep for remote analysis of medical images, to diagnose diabetic retinopathy and read scanner, MRI and mammography images.
facts.system: Tunisian AI medical imaging software (with InstaDeep)

systems.platform: AI software for remote medical image analysis
